newsitem.title: USA: American Standard unit tenders for snr notes.
newsitem.headline: American Standard unit tenders for snr notes.

text.p: American Standard Cos Inc, said Thursday its American Standard Inc unit had begun a cash tender offer for the unit's $150 million of outstanding 10-7/8 percent senior notes due 1999.

The unit is offering to pay a 75-basis-point spread over the June 20 yield on the 6-3/8 percent Treasury note due 1999, less a $5 consent fee per $1,000 principal amount of notes, plus accrued and unpaid interest.
The tender offer expires at midnight June 25 and is conditioned on, among other things, the receipt of noteholder consents by midnight June 17, the company said.
American Standard is a manufacturer of air conditioning systems, bathroom and kitchen fixtures, and vehicular braking systems.
